design_philosophy: High-end real estate magazine meets elite financial planner. Trustworthy, sophisticated, analytical but human. Avoid typical neon/tech dark mode.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-foreground
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight text-foreground

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Dashboard uses Bento Grid (Mode B) with gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense data.

component_guidelines.buttons: Solid backgrounds. Primary uses #C85A32. Hover state must explicitly lighten the background and maintain text contrast.
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless or 1px border (#302C28) with flat #141311 background. NO drop shadows.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to use #141311 background and #302C28 borders.
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts. Dark tooltips with 1px border. Accessible colors for lines.
component_guidelines.ai_advisor: Floating panel or sidebar with a subtle #B89B72 1px border to denote 'premium' feel.

testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the exact color hexes provided above.
The landing page hero must use the provided hero_background image with a bg-black/50 overlay.
Build the dashboard with customized Shadcn components. Remove default Vercel look (soft shadows) and replace with 1px solid borders and flat backgrounds.
Implement Rent vs Buy, EMI Calculator, and Investment Comparison using Recharts.
Use INR (₹) for all currency values by default.
The AI Advisor should return structured recommendations visually differentiated from the main text.
CRITICAL: The frontend uses .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx. Generate React components in .jsx/.js format.
